title: assay.ledger-cost/1
description: One line of a cost file `ledger/YYYY-MM.jsonl` in the ledger repository (docs/architecture/06-operations.md §1, 03-contracts.md §6c): a run's `reserved` record, written by `admit` at slot acquisition, or its `final` record, written by `release` or back-filled by the ledger reconcile. Keyed by `run_uid` and `kind`; `at` lies in the file's month. Unknown fields are rejected.

tier.description: The tier the run spent at: only tiers with a model stage.

roles.description: What each model-calling stage spent, or was reserved; each stage at most once.

cancelled.description: A `final` record charged at the run cap: the review died, was cancelled, or was back-filled. Never true on a `reserved` record.

repository.description: A GitHub `owner/name`; the name is not `.` or `..`.

aeu.description: AEU in dollars as an exact decimal string, as `Aeu` displays it: no leading zero but `0`, at most six fraction digits, no trailing zero.

time.description: A UTC instant to the millisecond, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ`.
